method: Opened each of ten NIH ODS original source fact sheets and inspected their recommended intake tables. Checked catalog's existing_dose_evidence against tables.
result: 10/10 source-backed baseline claims confirmed within their stated age groups; 10/10 require contextual age/life-stage and safety rules before clinical or app completion
